**New installation:** download `ScriptSCAD-<version>.zip`, unzip it in the Files app and move `ScriptSCAD Studio.js`, `ScriptSCAD Slicer.js` and the folder `ScriptSCAD` into *iCloud Drive › Scriptable*. Details: [README](https://github.com/DarthQuintus/ScriptSCAD-Suite/blob/main/README.md#installation-about-5-minutes).

**Update:** in Studio, *Settings › Check for updates* – or download `ScriptSCAD-<version>-update.zip`, unzip it and replace the folder `ScriptSCAD/app`. Your projects stay untouched.

**Neu installieren / aktualisieren:** siehe [README.de.md](https://github.com/DarthQuintus/ScriptSCAD-Suite/blob/main/README.de.md#installation-etwa-5-minuten).
